testFramework: Jest with ts-jest, Vue Test Utils (@vue/test-utils), Chai-style assertions via jest matchers

testPatterns.storeTests: Import state/getters/mutations/actions directly, call them with plain objects
testPatterns.mockPlugin: Cast as unknown as Plugin for lightweight Plugin stubs
testPatterns.itEach: Named objects with desc field for table-driven tests
testPatterns.assertions: toStrictEqual over toEqual, toHaveBeenCalledWith over toHaveBeenCalled
testPatterns.componentTests: shallowMount with stubs for child components, mockRouter for $router
